nodes.name: Webhook — Convert Request
nodes.notes: Starts the flow. Receives amount, from, to.

nodes.name: HTTP — Get Exchange Rates
nodes.notes: API call: GET open.er-api.com/v6/latest/<from>. Free, no key. Never Error is ON.

nodes.name: Code — Calculate Conversion
nodes.notes: Checks the input, multiplies by the rate, builds '100 GBP = 132.31 USD' or a clear error.

nodes.name: Respond — Converted Amount
nodes.notes: Replies with the result (or the error message).

parameters.content:
## Assignment 4 — Currency Converter

**Flow:** webhook → GET open.er-api.com (free, no key; Never Error ON) → Code calculates → reply

---

### 🧪 GBP → USD

```json
{ "amount": 100, "from": "GBP", "to": "USD" }
```

### 🧪 INR → EUR

```json
{ "amount": 2500, "from": "INR", "to": "EUR" }
```

### 🧪 Wrong currency (clear error, no crash)

```json
{ "amount": 50, "from": "GBP", "to": "XYZ" }
```
